title: Blue Notebook Review | Coffee Orders, Big Egos & Neighborhood Updates
description:
Sgt. Verbeck’s local fame might be getting to him ☕😄

In this week’s Blue Notebook Review, Sgt. Verbeck makes a bold coffee demand before shifting gears to what really matters—introducing Santa Monica’s Neighborhood Resources Officers and sharing updates from the field.

Filmed out in the community, this episode highlights how our officers are staying visible, connected, and responsive while addressing issues impacting neighborhoods citywide.

📍 Meet the officers
📋 Get the weekly update
👀 See what’s happening on the streets of Santa Monica

Thanks for tuning in—and yes, the coffee request was noted.

#BlueNotebookReview #SMPD #NeighborhoodPolicing #CommunityUpdate #OnPatrol
